meta.title: Phone access settings
meta.description: Settings → Phone access lists all network adapters without a type filter, including virtual, VPN, tunnel and disconnected interfaces. The choice is persisted; HTTPS uses the selected adapter IPv4 on port 63819 with a current secret link and QR. After an interrupted request the page verifies the saved choice and active gateway instead of falsely declaring startup failed. No-IPv4 adapters remain visible and selectable. Requires @local/dsh-phone-secure. Routing and Windows Firewall can require separate permission; no automatic administrator prompts. The QR grants owner access; keep it private.
